<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Adds `.coderabbit.yaml` configuring CodeRabbit: sets language to `en-US`, enables `knowledge_base.code_guidelines`, defines path-based filters (excluding client-go, generated Go/OpenAPI, and vendor files), provides detailed per-path review instructions for APIs, controllers, webhooks, scheduler, tests, Helm charts, and site docs, and enables auto-review with title/branch/label rules.

## Changes

**CodeRabbit configuration**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**CodeRabbit configuration and global settings** <br> ` .coderabbit.yaml`|Adds top-level settings: `language: en-US`, enables `knowledge_base.code_guidelines` (via `AGENTS.md`), and defines `reviews.request_changes_workflow: false` and `reviews.path_filters` to ignore `client-go/**`, generated Go/OpenAPI files (`*_generated*.go`, `zz_generated.*.go`, `openapi_generated.go`), and `vendor/**`.|
|**Per-path review instructions** <br> ` .coderabbit.yaml`|Adds `reviews.path_instructions` covering CRD API conventions/backwards compatibility (`apis/**/*.go`), controller reconciliation correctness/idempotency and tests, webhook validation/mutation and config-sync expectations, constants naming/uniqueness checks, scheduler correctness/performance, integration and e2e test conventions (envtest, Ginkgo-Gomega, cleanup), Helm chart template/value consistency, `site/**/*.md` technical accuracy, and general `**/*_test.go` test-writing guidance.|
|**Auto-review behavior and restrictions** <br> ` .coderabbit.yaml`|Enables `reviews.auto_review`, sets `reviews.auto_review.ignore_title_keywords` (`WIP`, `DO NOT MERGE`), disables draft handling, restricts `base_branches` to `main`, and excludes labels including `needs-ok-to-test`, `do-not-merge/work-in-progress`, and `cncf-cla: no` from auto-review.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

> 🐇 A rabbit tucks a YAML neat,
> Language set and filters meet,
> AGENTS whisper review advice,
> Paths and tests get scoped and nice,
> Tiny file, tidy stride — hop bright!

</details>
